Definition
[Hyperbolic foliation] \group foliations Source: thurston:page-0072, thurston:page-0073, thurston:page-0074 A codimension-$k$ foliation is a $\G $-structure locally modelled on $\R ^{n-k}\times \R ^k$ with coordinate changes preserving horizontal $(n-k)$-planes. Given a pseudogroup $ on a $k$-manifold $N$, an $-foliation has transverse changes in $. For hyperbolic isometries this is a codimension-$k$ hyperbolic foliation; its developing map $D:\widetilde M\to N$ is a submersion and its holonomy satisfies $D\circ T_\alpha =H(\alpha )\circ D$.
